raw_html: [[Sneak Attack Bonus| Sneak Attack Bonus +1]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Sneak Attack Bonus| Sneak Attack Bonus +1]]''' : Provides a +1 Enhancement modifier to your attack bonus and a +2 Enhancement bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.
